name: clarity-refined-documents-only
description: A WIP refinement suggests optional clarification of only materially changed documents and preserves links into an untouched design. Stage test-files as a workspace root outside any SKILL.md ancestor.
prompt: Use /kk:design to refine only implementation.md for archive-label in docs/feat/wip/archive-label/. Make its implementation steps concrete using the accepted design; leave design.md and tasks.md unchanged. Stop at handoff, before implementation or independent review.
trap: The agent automatically runs clarification, suggests it for every WIP document, changes task state, or breaks links while refining the implementation plan.

assertions.text: Drafting/task instructions and resolved profile content load before full WIP document reads; no fresh-idea sub-phases are rerun and neither clarify-docs nor the shared clarity procedure is loaded.

Only implementation.md is refined, with no separate clarity pass or extra summary; design.md and tasks.md stay byte-identical. The response suggests optional /kk:clarify-docs naming only implementation.md before recommending /kk:review-design, without executing either follow-up.
Implementation steps identify catalog.md, preserve visible clickable archived entries and unchanged active entries, pair steps with verification, and retain the design.md#label-contract link.

The color decision stays unresolved and owned by catalog maintainers; no task is marked complete or runtime behavior invented. Handoff names pending Task 2 and /kk:implement without running it or making clarification a required gate.
